reviewer.tool: agent image read tool on the PNG files listed below

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: The windshield and side glass are bright and contain dotted/broken white speckles along the upper edge and wiper line. Authored alpha-BLEND coverage and transmission are not separated.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Roof/window interpenetration reads as a single flat white plate rather than layered glass with depth; mesh-centre sorting cannot order the authored transparent surfaces.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.where: observed during T20 capture; see report captures loadSeconds and settle diagnostics
defects.description: Car reported a verified complete model near 5 s, but the viewport remained background-only until about 15 s on this machine. Texture counters were already stable at 30 textures. T20 waits for a non-blank, quiet frame; T23 must make complete-load readiness include that drawable/texture state.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: The terminal ResourceLimit after visible microscope geometry was recorded in T19 but did not reproduce in the T20 run. The label stays; a passing load here is not evidence that the intermittent failure is fixed.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: The generated Khronos-style tinted, rough and clear transmission spheres render almost identically as clear glass. KHR_materials_transmission, volume attenuation/color and IOR do not differentiate the three material roles; this is exactly the route the Khronos reference is meant to expose.

defects.label: known-defect
defects.description: Installed F3D 3.5.0 renders the Camera lens as a flat pale/gray disk in the shipped preset. This remains a reference observation, not an accepted glass target.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: The shipped preset produced 1920x1350 for a requested 1280x900 because the preset is DPI-aware; the no-config controlled run produced the requested 1280x900. These are different reference conditions and must not be numerically compared as matched frames.

positives: Preview3D Camera lens remains dark with visible reflection and depth in Studio; it is not the gray F3D appearance.
Clay renders Car and Camera form without material distraction; Directional adds a visible raking light.
All 53 T20 captures passed the settled/complete/non-blank contract after the wait-for-visible fix.
T21a restored the display-space #1C1C1E backdrop; regenerated generated-fixture references show the intended darker backdrop without a change to model lighting, glass roles or the grid.
F3D installed 3.5.0 rendered Car and Camera with both the shipped preset and recorded controlled settings.

acceptance.t21aBackdropRepromotion: The 15 generated-fixture accepted references were re-promoted after the display-space backdrop change. The promoted images were inspected; the only intended delta is the darker #1C1C1E backdrop.
acceptance.note: Accepted references defend the reviewed current behavior against regressions. They do not certify Studio/Clay/Directional quality; the defect list above remains open.
